title: Fix oneOf/anyOf subclasses to use implements instead of extends
description:
**Problem:**
Generated oneOf/anyOf subclasses try to extend the sealed parent class, but fail because the parent only has factory constructors:

```dart
abstract class Payment {
  factory Payment.fromJson(...) {...}  // Only factory constructor
  Map<String, dynamic> toJson();
}

class BankTransferPayment extends Payment {  // ❌ Can't extend
  // Has generative constructor
}
```

Error: "The class 'BankTransferPayment' can't extend 'Payment' because 'Payment' only has factory constructors"

**Root Cause:**
The model template marks subclasses with `extends` via x-extends-sealed-class vendor extension, but Dart doesn't allow extending classes with only factory constructors. Should use `implements` instead.

**Required Fix:**
1. Change oneOf/anyOf model template to use `implements` instead of `extends`
2. Subclasses must implement the `toJson()` abstract method
3. No changes needed to fromJson factory (already in parent)

**Alternative:**
Add generative constructor to parent sealed class (but this breaks the sealed pattern).

**Test:**
Generate composition spec, verify BankTransferPayment implements Payment, dart analyze shows no generative constructor errors.

**Blocks:** Dart-ACDC-generator-1vb
close_reason: Fixed by changing template from 'extends' to 'implements' for sealed classes. Dart doesn't allow extending classes with only factory constructors. Subclasses now properly implement the interface and override toJson(). Verified across all 6 sample specs - zero 'no_generative_constructors_in_superclass' errors.

title: Fix Logging Integration in api_client.mustache

**Spec:** openspec/changes/add-acdc-integration/specs/acdc-features/spec.md → 'Logging Configuration' requirement

   - Conditionally pass `sensitiveFields` when redactSensitiveData is true
   - Conditionally pass `delegate` when customLogger is provided
   - Map LogConfig.customLogger to dart_acdc's AcdcLogDelegate type

2. **log_config.mustache** (generator/src/main/resources/dart-acdc/log_config.mustache):
   - Update `customLogger` type from `Function?` to `AcdcLogDelegate?` (matching dart_acdc API)
   - Ensure `LogLevel` import from dart_acdc is correct
   - Add dart_acdc import for AcdcLogDelegate type

**Spec Scenarios Covered:**
- Logging with default settings (LogLevel.info, redact sensitive data)
- Debug logging (headers + bodies logged)
- Sensitive data redaction
- Custom logger integration (delegate)
- Logging disabled (null check)

**Tests Needed:**
- Java unit test: verify logging builder calls in generated api_client.dart
- Dart test: verify ApiClient.createDio() with various LogConfig combinations
- Verify generated code compiles with `dart analyze`
close_reason: Replaced .withLogLevel() + .withSensitiveFields() with single .withLogging(level:, sensitiveFields:, delegate:) call. Updated LogConfig.customLogger type from Function? to AcdcLogDelegate?.

Generated api_client.dart doesn't match the actual dart_acdc library API, causing 13+ errors:
- withAuthentication() method doesn't exist on AcdcClientBuilder

The api_client.mustache template was written based on outdated/assumed dart_acdc API instead of the actual published library.

**Required Fix:**
1. Inspect actual dart_acdc library API (v0.2.0 from GitHub)
2. Update api_client.mustache template to match real API
3. Update all configuration templates (auth_config, cache_config, log_config, etc.) if needed

Generate composition spec, run dart analyze, verify no errors in lib/api_client.dart
